data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 傲慢女王的沦陷呜咽
data.description: 层叠华丽的哥特长裙被蛮横地堆积到腰际，平日里不可一世的吸血鬼大小姐被反压在书桌上。随着一次次不容抗拒的撞击，她的傲慢彻底碎裂成带着泪光的甜腻哀鸣。
data.location: dim gothic library across massive antique polished mahogany desk covered in books
data.action: 被反按在大理石书桌上紧抓桌垫，泪光闪烁娇喘哀鸣
data.lighting: dramatic moonlight pouring through stained glass windows casting vivid violet hues
data.promptProse: In a moonlit mansion library, Kirie is bent forward over the heavy mahogany desk clutching the blotter with trembling hands as silver window light catches the tears spilling down her deeply flushed cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Pinned forward over the dark mahogany library desk with her black-gloved hands gripping the desk mat and her lavish black gothic velvet ballgown bunched high around her waist, she weeps tearful gasps under the window moonlight as her partner thrusts into her from behind.
data.nsfwProse: Her layered jet-black Victorian gothic dress and crimson ruffled petticoats are hoisted high to her waist above elbow-length black satin gloves, leaving her bare hips and rear exposed during standing rear entry.
